data.name: Lutfat
data.gender_notes: Lutfat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'lutf' meaning 'to be kind', 'to be merciful', 'to be generous'. The name Lutfat means 'grace' and 'beauty'. The name Lutfat carries the meaning “Grace, Beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lutfat usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's infinite grace and compassion towards us.
data.etymology: Lutfat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, Beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lutfat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

The name Lutfat has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the importance of benevolence, empathy, and moral character. Its usage dates back to the early Islamic period, reflecting the values of compassion and kindness emphasized in the Quran.
